record.original_question: For every system (X, X, µ, T, S) and bounded functions f, g, do the commuting-transformation averages (1/N) Σ f(T^n x) g(S^n x) converge pointwise almost everywhere?

evidence.quote: Problem 19. Let (X, X , µ, T, S) be a system and f, g ∈ L∞(µ) be functions. Show that the averages 1/N Σ f(T^n x) · g(S^n x) converge pointwise almost everywhere.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $(X,\mathcal{X},\mu)$ be a standard probability space, and let $T,S:X\to X$ be two measure-preserving transformations that commute, i.e. $T\circ S = S\circ T$. For any pair of bounded measurable functions $f,g\in L^\infty(\mu)$, consider the double ergodic averages
$$A_N(f,g)(x) \;=\; \frac{1}{N}\sum_{n=1}^{N} f(T^n x)\,g(S^n x), \qquad x\in X,\ N\ge 1.$$
Prove or disprove: for every such system $(X,\mathcal{X},\mu,T,S)$ and every $f,g\in L^\infty(\mu)$, the sequence $A_N(f,g)(x)$ converges as $N\to\infty$ for $\mu$-almost every $x\in X$.
artifact.status_search_result: The pointwise almost-everywhere convergence of the double ergodic averages (1/N)Σ f(T^n x) g(S^n x) for commuting measure-preserving transformations T, S is a well-known long-standing open problem in ergodic theory. Norm (L^2) convergence was established by Conze–Lesigne, and pointwise convergence has been proved in special cases (e.g., randomized exponents, distal systems, strictly ergodic models, certain nilpotent settings), but the general deterministic pointwise problem remains unresolved as of recent literature.

status_evidence.title: Random Sequences and Pointwise Convergence of Multiple Ergodic Averages
status_evidence.snippet: Pointwise convergence is proved for randomized averages of the form (1/N)Σ f(T^n x) g(S^{a_n} x); the deterministic case remains open.
status_evidence.claim: The deterministic pointwise convergence problem for two commuting transformations is referenced as still open.

status_evidence.title: Pointwise convergence of multiple ergodic averages and strictly ergodic models
status_evidence.snippet: Establishes pointwise convergence in special structured (strictly ergodic) models, indicating the general problem for commuting T, S is not yet settled.
status_evidence.claim: Partial progress only; general case unresolved.
